Each deployment profile must declare SLOs for: policy-decision freshness/latency, command-dispatch latency, event processing lag, durable outbox age, reconciliation age for unknown actions, deletion propagation, evidence integrity check success, audit gap duration, recovery time, projection staleness, and HAL repair rollback. Missing SLOs block production readiness for a deployment but do not block a runtime-agnostic Phase-0 specification. Authorization freshness, evidence integrity, tenant isolation and unknown-outcome correctness are hard safety properties, not relaxable SLOs.
